target_pattern: Use demonstrative adjectives and pronouns (este/ese/aquel + gender/number forms, plus esto/eso) to point to specific objects, unknown concepts, and time references naturally.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one fixed this/that form without gender and number agreement.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Demonstratives must match noun gender and number; neuter forms refer to ideas or unknown things.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using the correct demonstrative form. No answer key until the end.
prompts_en: These keys are on the table.
That mountain over there is beautiful.
I do not want those shoes.
Do you want those flowers over there?
I do not want those ones. (los cuadernos)
At that time, everything was different.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Este libro es interesante. -> change to feminine singular (revista).
Base: Esa silla es cómoda. -> change to plural.
Base: Aquella casa es antigua. -> change to masculine singular (edificio).
Base: Quiero este. -> change noun reference to feminine (camisa).
Base: No quiero esos. -> change to singular masculine.
Base: ¿Quieres esta mesa? -> change to pronoun form (this one).
Base: ¿Qué es esto? -> change to What is that?
Base: Quiero hablar de eso. -> make it negative.
Base: En ese entonces, trabajaba mucho. -> change to aquel entonces.
Base: Estos zapatos son caros. -> change demonstrative to farther distance.
Base: No quiero esa. -> turn into question.
Base: Aquellos niños están en el parque. -> change to feminine plural (niñas).
Base: Este teléfono funciona bien. -> change to plural (teléfonos).
Base: ¿Quieres ese cuaderno? -> answer yes using pronoun.
Base: Esta puerta está cerrada. -> change to those doors.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the most natural option and write in Spanish.
prompts: This book (este libro vs esta libro)
That chair (esa silla vs ese silla)
These windows (estas ventanas vs estos ventanas)
Those cars (esos carros vs esas carros)
That mountain over there (aquella montaña vs esa montaña) with far-distance emphasis.
What is this? (¿qué es esto? vs ¿qué es este?) unknown object.
I want this one. (la mesa) (quiero esta vs quiero este)
I do not want those ones. (los libros) (no quiero esos vs no quiero esas)
At that time (en ese entonces vs en ese tiempo) in this lesson frame.
Back then with stronger distance (en aquel entonces vs en ese entonces).

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: You want this table, not that one.
Those documents are important.
This meeting is short, but that meeting is long.
You do not want those shoes over there.
This phone works and that one does not.
These emails are urgent.
That office is far from here.
This chair is more comfortable.
You prefer those options.
Those keys are not yours.
You want this one (feminine object).
You do not understand this.
At that time you worked in another city.
Back then your schedule was different.
These plans are better than those.

prompts_en: I do not want that one, I want this one.
What is this supposed to mean?
That over there is my office.
These are the ones I need.
Back then, we did not have this problem.
Those over there are not available.
I am talking about that, not this.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Noun changes but demonstrative stays singular.

common_errors.mistake: Using adjective forms for unknown objects
Overusing aquel for all that contexts
common_errors.correct_spanish: ese/esa usually works for normal distance

common_errors.why_it_happens: Accent marks are dropped in fast typing.
Learner does not separate with-noun vs no-noun forms.

common_errors.mistake: Wrong pronoun based on hidden noun gender
common_errors.why_it_happens: Reference noun is not mentally tracked.

common_errors.mistake: Literal English order for time phrase
Using ese for near speaker objects

controlled_recombination: Estas llaves están sobre la mesa.
En ese entonces, todo era diferente.
pattern_mutation: Aquellas niñas están en el parque.
reverse_conceptual_expression: Aquello de allá es mi oficina.
